Class UserEventService

java.lang.Object
york.studentevents.events.UserEventService
public class UserEventService extends Object
Application service exposing user-related business operations.

This service forms the Service layer of the stack, sitting between the controllers and repositories. Persistence is delegated to the injected repository; the service holds no state of its own.
